description: Primary-source rulebooks for meet scoring point tables. Every point table in packages/core/src/lib/ncaaScoringRules.ts traces to one of these by sourceId + sha256, per CLAUDE.md § 'Data provenance'. ncaascoring.rule7.txt is a verbatim pdfplumber text extraction of the PDF of the same name, checked in so the transcription can be diffed without a PDF toolchain. Note the PDF renders the rule-number period as U+FFFD in text extraction (e.g. 'ARTICLE 1�'); that is an extraction artifact of the source font, not a transcription error.

sources.document: NCAA Swimming & Diving Rules — Rule 7, Scoring
coversSections: 7-1 Dual Meets (six lanes or more; five lanes or fewer; no contest/forfeit; diving dual meets)
7-4 Invitational Meets (host-published table — not fixed by rule)
notSourcedHere: Rule 7-6-6 (24 competitors): the point table is published, but the rule does not state which place range each final contests. Modelled as an unsourced finals split — see NCAA_FORMAT_RULESETS['championship-24'].
Rule 7-6-7 (more than 24 competitors): 'shall model the pattern reflected in Rules 7-6-3, 7-6-4, 7-6-5 and 7-6-6' — no table is published, so none is implemented.
NAIA and NFHS point tables — different governing bodies, different documents, not fetched.
